scope: Original step 1-9537 runs only; continuation logs are excluded.
method: Parse every Megatron iteration record, discard steps 1-100 as startup warm-up, and summarize elapsed time per iteration. Tokens per second use global batch 256 times sequence length 8192.
time_to_loss_method: Find the first downward crossing of a target validation NLL and linearly interpolate between adjacent 250-step evaluations. Estimate training-only time as interpolated step multiplied by the run's stable median step time.
limitations: Validation uses an advancing iterator; only equal-step evaluations use the same validation batches.
Interpolated crossing steps are estimates rather than measured checkpoints.
Step timing excludes validation, checkpointing, launch, and queue time.
This is time-to-quality on the matched 64-device setup, not a hardware-normalized FLOP count.
